left.title: Puerto Rico’s power restoration efforts hit a snag as Trump-connected company gets the boot
left.body: Lawmakers call on federal government to take more active role.
left.roundup: The FBI is investigating the $300 million contract to restore Puerto Rico's power after it was awarded to a very small company with ties to Donald Trump's Interior Secretary, Ryan Zinke. The company only had 2 employees with Hurricane Marie hit.

center.title: FBI Is Probing Puerto Rico Power Contract
center.body: The Federal Bureau of Investigation is investigating a decision by Puerto Rico’s power authority to award a $300 million contract to a tiny Montana energy firm to rebuild electrical infrastructure damaged in Hurricane Maria, according to people familiar with the matter.

right.title: FBI probes shady Puerto Rico power contract
right.body: The FBI has launched an investigation into a $300 million contract awarded to a tiny Montana electric company to ​help rebuild Puerto Rico’s power grid after the island was decimated by Hurricane Maria, it was reported on Monday.
